title: 月光下的温迪恩森林湖
author: @JUAN JOSÉ ARANGO E.
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,电影感 / 电影剧照,群像 / 情侣,风景 / 自然
prompt_en: Create a dark cinematic fantasy scene inspired by Carl Reinecke's Undine sonata: a moonlit German forest pool at night, with black trees and tangled branches enclosing a cold lake. Show exactly five human figures: one male figure in the left foreground seen only as a near-black silhouette from behind, crouched or standing at the water's edge; one central water nymph rising waist-deep from the lake with long soaked dark hair, pale wet skin, and a translucent drenched gown clinging to her body; and three ghostly pale faces or heads partially submerged in the water behind her, spaced across the middle and right background like drowned witnesses. The central nymph should be the brightest focal point, lit by cool blue moonlight and mist, while the man remains almost completely unlit. The water should look black, rippling, reflective, and protective, with small waves around the nymph and dim highlights on mossy rocks in the foreground. Use a realistic film-still style, gothic romantic atmosphere, low-key lighting, teal-blue color grading, heavy shadows, fog, wet textures, shallow depth of field, and a sense of betrayal and quiet menace. Keep the composition wide and horizontal, like a dramatic movie frame, with no text, no modern objects, and no visible instruments.\

prompt_en: Create a polished Japanese tech advertising banner for a mobile app, widescreen 16:9, with a futuristic blue-to-purple gradient background filled with glowing network lines, connection nodes, soft lens flares, and subtle digital particles. At the top center, place a modern app logo: a cyan hexagon icon with large white letters “SC” and a small circuit symbol inside the C, followed by the brand text “SKILL Cert by AI” in a clean sans-serif font, with “SKILL” large and black, “Cert” below it in black, and “by AI” smaller in cyan. Center the composition around a bold Japanese headline in very large white text with a dark navy outline and soft drop shadow: AIが出題する資格バトルアプリ. Directly below, add a second line of medium-large white Japanese text with the same outline and shadow: 200以上の資格でオンライン対戦. In the middle foreground, place one large glossy rounded rectangular call-to-action button in bright cyan with subtle gradient, bevel, and shadow, containing bold white Japanese text: 今すぐ無料で対戦. Show exactly 3 smartphone mockups arranged around the center: 1 on the lower left, tilted slightly right, showing a leaderboard app screen with a line graph at the top, small profile avatars, ranking rows, and Japanese UI labels; 1 large phone on the lower right, tilted slightly left, showing a multiple-choice quiz screen with Japanese question text and radio-button answers plus a cyan bottom button; 1 smaller phone on the far right edge, angled inward, showing a darker dashboard-style screen with charts and Japanese text. Add exactly 4 floating UI graphic clusters in the background: 1 analytics line-chart panel near the upper left, 1 holographic cube/dashboard cluster near the upper right, 1 glowing wireframe brain or neural sphere near the lower left-center behind the button, and 1 hexagon chart/card element near the right-center. Use a sleek AI, SaaS, and edtech marketing aesthetic, high contrast, crisp typography, layered depth, neon glow accents, and premium app-promo lighting.\

title: 豪华德国旅行海报
author: Chu Judy
categories: 海报 / 传单,产品营销,复古 / 怀旧,摄影,电影感 / 电影剧照,风景 / 自然,建筑 / 室内,美食 / 饮品
prompt_en:
Create a luxurious vintage-style travel poster for Germany, designed like a premium tourism campaign advertisement. Use a grand, symmetrical composition with elegant editorial typography and a refined gold border frame with tiny ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a small gold national emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large serif title reading GERMANY in deep navy blue. Under it, add the slogan “LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.” in gold uppercase, followed by a smaller classic serif tagline reading “Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.” with a tiny horizontal accent in the colors black, red, and gold.

Show a majestic panoramic montage of iconic German scenery at golden hour under a softly glowing blue sky with scattered clouds. On the left, feature a fairy-tale white hilltop castle resembling Neuschwanstein, perched above autumn trees. In the center distance, place dramatic alpine mountains. On the right, show a historic European riverside city with dense red-roofed houses, an arched stone bridge crossing the water, a domed cathedral, and a towering Gothic cathedral with twin spires. Add calm river reflections and a small white sightseeing boat at the lower right. The image should feel nostalgic, romantic, and aspirational, with warm sunlight, crisp architectural detail, and rich cinematic color grading.

Along the lower middle, include exactly 5 gold line-art cultural icons with labels beneath them, evenly spaced in a horizontal row: “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, “RICH HERITAGE”, “VIBRANT CULTURE”, “AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS”, and “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”.

At the bottom, create a dark horizontal food showcase strip with the centered heading “SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY” in gold. Inside the strip, include exactly 5 framed food panels, each labeled in white uppercase beneath the image: “BREZEL”, “BRATWURST”, “KARTOFFELSALAT”, “SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE”, and “GERMAN BEER”. Show each item as an appetizing close-up: a glossy pretzel on a plate, grilled sausages with sauerkraut, creamy potato salad, a slice of Black Forest cake topped with cream and cherry, and a frothy beer mug. Keep the overall design polished, high-end, poster-like, and suitable for a luxury destination campaign.\

title: 舒芙蕾煎饼动漫故事板
author: ヴェルモット
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,产品营销,电影感 / 电影剧照,动漫 / 漫画,美食 / 饮品
prompt_en:
Goal: Create an ultra-high-quality anime cooking storyboard sheet for a 15-second food video about jiggly extra-thick soufflé pancakes.

Canvas: One wide horizontal 21:9 storyboard sheet with a black outer border and thin black grid lines. Arrange exactly 12 panels in chronological order, in a 3-row by 4-column grid. Each panel is cinematic, warm, golden, highly detailed, with shallow depth of field, glossy food highlights, steam, sparkles, and realistic anime-style rendering.

Visual style: Premium Japanese anime food commercial look, painterly-realistic textures, close-up camera angles, warm morning kitchen lighting, amber reflections, soft bokeh background, appetizing macro detail, no captions, no panel numbers, no watermark.

Storyboard panels, exactly 12:
1. Ingredient flat lay: eggs in a wicker basket, milk, flour, sugar, butter cubes, vanilla, honey or syrup, berries, cream, and bowls on a rustic wooden table.
2. Egg separation close-up: hands crack an egg over a glass bowl, bright yolk suspended while egg white drips down.
3. Meringue whipping: electric beaters whip glossy white egg whites into stiff peaks, with splashes and sparkling highlights.
4. Batter folding: a spatula gently folds fluffy meringue into pale yellow pancake batter in a glass bowl.
5. Butter melting: a cube of butter sizzles and foams in a frying pan over a blue gas flame.
6. Batter piping/pouring: thick soufflé batter is poured into a tall mound in the pan, forming a soft spiral shape.
7. Covered steaming: the thick pancake cooks under a glass lid in the pan, condensation and steam visible, pancake rising high.
8. Flipping moment: a spatula lifts and flips a tall golden soufflé pancake, showing a browned top and airy sides, with flying crumbs and steam.
9. Browning close-up: extreme close-up of the pancake surface becoming evenly golden and crisp around the edges.
10. Stacking: three thick soufflé pancakes stacked on a white plate in a cozy sunlit kitchen, perfectly round and fluffy.
11. Final plating: stack topped with a square pat of butter and glossy syrup pouring down, surrounded by strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, powdered sugar, and a small whipped cream garnish.
12. Eating shot: fork cuts into the pancake, revealing soft airy interior; syrup flows over the cut edge, berries around the plate, dramatic appetizing close-up.

Subject details: The pancakes should look very thick, soft, springy, and trembling with a soufflé-like texture. Emphasize golden-brown tops, pale fluffy sides, syrup shine, melting butter, and visible air bubbles.

Constraints: Use exactly 12 panels, exactly 3 rows and 4 columns, chronological cooking sequence from ingredients to eating, no text inside the image, no people’s faces, only hands and tools where needed. Keep the overall theme centered on extra-thick soufflé pancakes, with warm golden morning kitchen light, high-detail cinematic anime food illustration, and 21:9 wide storyboard sheet.\

title: 复古黄金时代偶像海报

categories: 海报 / 传单,电影感 / 电影剧照,复古 / 怀旧,肖像 / 自拍,网红 / 模特,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical vintage cinematic celebrity poster styled like an aged “Golden Era Icon” archive file, featuring KYRIE CHEUNG as the dominant typography and a moody side-profile portrait on the right.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, dark sepia and burnt-red palette, distressed paper texture, worn edges, scratches, dust, faded ink, subtle vignette, archival classified-document aesthetic.

Layout: Left third is typography-heavy; right two-thirds show a young East Asian man standing in profile facing left. Top left contains a boxed label reading “GOLDEN ERA ICON” with thin horizontal rules, two small stars, and a circular dragon emblem. Below it, place huge stacked condensed block letters: “KYRIE” on top and “CHEUNG” below, in tall vintage gold type. Under the name, add a thin divider with a small star, then the decade label “2020s”. Beneath that, add the quote “世人皆 Gay, 我独Straight” in gold, mixing Chinese characters with the English words Gay and Straight. Lower left includes a faded red circular stamp reading “ARCHIVE / CLASSIFIED / UNDERWORLD”. Bottom left reads FILE No.01 with thin decorative lines and small star/floral ornaments.

Subject details: The person is a slim young adult East Asian male with dark slightly messy medium-length hair, shown from head to thigh in right-side profile. His face is deliberately blurred/obscured by a rectangular soft blur block. He wears a loose off-white long-sleeve button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, tucked into dark high-waisted trousers with a black belt. One hand rests in his trouser pocket, and a wristwatch is visible. Pose is relaxed, elegant, and introspective.

Background: Dark old Chinese architectural setting with a deep red wall, shadowy roof eaves at the top, decorative circular roof ornaments and patterned trim. Lighting is low, dramatic, warm, and directional, casting soft shadows and emphasizing the vintage poster mood.

Visual style: 1930s–1970s Chinese noir poster meets modern editorial photography, grainy film texture, letterpress typography, aged gold ink, high contrast, cinematic shadows, historical archive design. Use exactly 1 portrait figure, 1 dragon emblem, 2 large name words, 1 decade label, 1 quote block, 1 circular classified stamp, and 1 file-number block. No extra logos or watermarks.\

author: 鍋田匠
categories: 社交媒体帖子,漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,插画,电影感 / 电影剧照,角色,建筑 / 室内
prompt_en: A cinematic anime-inspired digital illustration set at night inside a cozy artist's room with large window panes and a warm city glow outside. On the left, a young male artist with dark brown messy hair sits at a cluttered desk in side profile, leaning forward with one hand near his mouth and the other drawing with a pen on a tablet or sketchbook. The desk is covered with exactly 1 pen cup filled with pencils, 1 coffee mug, 1 open laptop or pen-display showing a sunset landscape, 1 spiral sketchbook with manga-style character drawings, 2 additional drawing books or pads, 1 small stack of about 4 books, and many scattered art cards and printed illustrations. On the right, a luminous ethereal anime girl made of blue-white light appears life-sized, facing the artist with both hands gently extended toward him. Her form is translucent, delicate, and composed of glowing contour lines, starry particles, and flowing strands of light, with long windblown hair and a soft dress-like silhouette. Between them, a magical stream of golden and white light spirals upward from the artist's desk into the air, connecting creator and creation. Inside this swirling ribbon are exactly 12 to 16 floating image fragments and sketch pages: monochrome character sketches, scenic sunset paintings, small photo-like panels, and tiny icon-like cards, all orbiting in a curved arc from lower center to upper left and upper center. Around the upper half of the image, dozens of glowing musical notes float through the air, mixed with sparkling particles, creating the feeling that inspiration has become visible sound and memory. The palette is rich warm gold and amber on the artist's side, contrasted with cool electric blue and white on the spirit girl's side, with dramatic rim light, volumetric glow, intricate particles, and a dreamy emotional atmosphere. Composition is vertical, highly detailed, intimate, and poetic, evoking the relationship between you and me as artist and imagined muse, where drawings, music, memories, and fantasy physically manifest in the room. Add a small handwritten note card on the desk with 二人だけの物語, and display one prominent artwork on the desk and one floating scenic panel using sunset sky over a distant city.\

title: 网络奇幻机械堕落天使海报
author: EbonWraith
categories: 海报 / 传单,游戏素材,赛博朋克 / 科幻,电影感 / 电影剧照,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en: Create a high-quality vertical poster in a modern “Interpol Wanted Analysis” style, designed as a classified international intelligence investigation document mixed with dark cyber-fantasy fashion editorial visuals. The overall atmosphere must feel cold, mysterious, premium, cinematic and slightly divine, combining the visual language of high-level Interpol files, biometric analysis sheets, celestial fugitive tracking systems, and futuristic forensic graphics. The subject is a Mechfallen Angel with long flowing silver-white hair in intricate braids, pointed elf ears, glowing ice-blue eyes, and an extremely detailed golden dragon-headed crescent scythe weapon covered in glowing runes and ice. She wears luxurious dark red velvet and fur cape over intricate silver and gold biomechanical armor with sacred engravings. The poster must include realistic identification elements such as profile analysis layouts, facial recognition markers, serial numbers, barcode systems, investigation notes, security stamps, confidential markings, digital scanning overlays, fingerprint sections, coordinate graphics, and layered document textures resembling advanced celestial criminal database files. Add modern decorative ornaments, icy blue neon accents, golden dragon motifs, and futuristic UI elements that strengthen the Mechfallen aesthetic without overcrowding the composition. Show the subject in dynamic, elegant and emotionally powerful poses with different face angles — never stiff or identical to the reference. Her expression must feel alive, cold, regal, melancholic yet defiant, like an ancient fallen seraph who has embraced winter and storm. Use cinematic dramatic lighting with strong volumetric god rays, falling snow, icy particles, realistic shadows, and high-detail rendering. The color palette should be dominated by deep reds, icy blues, silver, gold, and dark gothic tones. Typography across the poster must be bold, futuristic, and elegant, mixing clean technical fonts with gothic serif elements. Every text element should feel intentionally designed, mysterious, and visually striking. The final visual must feel like a luxury classified dossier of a fallen ice seraph mixed with a high-end dark fantasy fashion campaign poster. Ultra-detailed, highly polished, visually dynamic, professional-grade composition, rendered in ultra-sharp 8K resolution.\

categories: 海报 / 传单,动漫 / 漫画,插画,角色,动物 / 生物
prompt_en: Create a dynamic full-body anime poster illustration of an anthropomorphic dragon-wolf hybrid warrior on a clean white background, posed in a powerful crouching action stance with one knee raised, one hand reaching forward with sharp claws, and the other hand tucked into the hoodie pocket. The character has dark charcoal-black scales or fur, a long thick tail with red markings, spiky swept-back red hair and mane-like neck spikes, tall pointed red-and-black horns, angular black cheek fins, glowing red eyes, a snarling mouth with visible sharp teeth, and red claw tips. Dress the character in a deep red oversized hoodie with white drawstrings, a front pouch pocket, heavy folds, and a centered chest graphic of the character’s own fierce dragon head logo inside a circular emblem; add a small heart-like patch on the upper sleeve and a dark rectangular patch below it. Pair it with black tactical cargo pants featuring multiple straps, buckles, knee padding, thigh pouches, utility pockets, and loose gathered fabric, plus white athletic sneakers with red accents and gray laces. Surround the figure with bold red painterly slash effects, curved energy arcs, ink splatters, small black debris flecks, and two sharp red starburst spark shapes, emphasizing speed and aggression. Use crisp cel-shaded anime line art, high-contrast lighting, dramatic foreshortening, saturated red highlights, detailed clothing wrinkles, clean white negative space, and a polished character-poster composition with no readable text.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot-style image of a ChatGPT image generation interface demonstrating multiple image outputs from one request.

Canvas: Landscape 16:9 screenshot crop, white background, resembling a mobile or narrow desktop chat interface. Keep the composition slightly zoomed in so the right edge of the image carousel is visible.

Layout: At the top right, place one rounded light-gray user message bubble containing Japanese text. Beneath it on the left, show the status line “Thought for 2m 7s ›” in light gray. Below that, show one large generated image preview with rounded corners, and a narrow strip of additional generated thumbnails on the right side.

Text content: The user bubble should read: “絵コンテを参考に今回のベた塗アニメMVで使用する背景イラストを被写体なしで10個作成してください。\nテイスト強めで汚らしっぷつぷ感はなくしてください。プロアニメーターとして画質はよくしてほしいです。\n16:9　n=10”. Highlight the “n=10” part as the key detail.

Generated image preview: The main preview is a pastel anime background illustration of an empty stylized street with no characters, inspired by a colorful East Asian shopping district. Use soft cel-shaded anime line art, bright pastel blue, pink, yellow, and mint tones, lanterns hanging from buildings, decorative circular signs, shopfronts on both sides, a centered vanishing point, and a decorative archway in the distance. The image should look like a professional anime MV background, 16:9, clean and polished.

Discrete visible elements to include: exactly 1 user message bubble; exactly 1 status line; exactly 1 large main generated image; exactly 3 narrow vertical thumbnails partially visible on the right, each showing a different pastel anime background; exactly 2 circular overlay buttons on the main preview, one dark “編集” edit button at bottom left and one white downward arrow download button near bottom right; exactly 1 small dark share/upload icon button at the lower-right corner of the main preview.

Annotation: Add thick hand-drawn yellow marker annotations over the screenshot: exactly 1 yellow circle around “n=10”, exactly 1 thick yellow arrow pointing from the circled “n=10” down toward the right-side thumbnail strip, and exactly 1 tall yellow bracket-like outline encircling the vertical thumbnail strip. The yellow marker should look casual and drawn by hand.

Style: Clean UI screenshot aesthetic with subtle antialiasing, light gray interface elements, Japanese text rendered legibly, and bright yellow annotation marks. Use n=10 as the highlighted parameter in the chat message. Keep the screenshot realistic, not a poster or infographic.\

title: 概念中文社论海报
author: LAMA.Ai
categories: 海报 / 传单,社交媒体帖子,极简主义,电影感 / 电影剧照,文字 / 排版,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en: 请根据我提供的【主题】，自动生成一张横版 4:3 的高级中文概念海报。【主题】：慢病管理心法 你的任务不是机械解释主题，而是先理解这个主题背后的：- 情绪气质- 心理张力- 传播对象- 社会意味- 隐喻方向- 它可能对应的“被长期观察后才会说出的提醒”然后把它转译成一张具有：- 心理洞察感- 长期陪伴感- 安静观察感- 冷静提醒感- 轻微哲学意味- 高级中文编辑设计感 的概念海报。--- # 一、整体风格 生成一张横版 4:3高级中文概念海报，整体气质参考：- 中文编辑海报- 杂志封面感- 电影海报感- 旧报纸 / 旧书封面印刷感- brutalist typography（粗野主义大字排版）- dark cinematic poster（暗黑电影感）- grunge print texture（旧印刷颗粒与磨损质感）- psychological insight（心理洞察）- quiet observation（安静观察）- philosophical atmosphere（哲学感）画面必须克制、聪明、高级，不要廉价，不要模板感。--- # 二、画面主题逻辑 围绕【主题】自动生成一个核心表达方向：“像一个安静观察你很久的人，终于从长期互动、长期关系、长期生活经验中，捞出几条真正准确、轻微刺痛、但并不冒犯的提醒。”这不是鸡汤，不是喊口号，不是互联网金句堆砌。 而是那种：- 有点准- 有点轻- 偶尔还有点不太好反驳 的提醒感。--- # 三、版式结构 ## 左侧（约 70%）使用巨大中文标题排版作为主体视觉。要求：- 字非常大- 形成明显压迫感与存在感- 像杂志封面 + 电影海报 + 旧报纸印刷- 排版要有呼吸感，不要乱- 文字层级明确- 画面中心可以在大字之间，隐约嵌入一只真实眼睛 - 眼睛不要惊悚 - 要像“被长期观察但并不冒犯”的隐喻 - 半藏在大字结构里，若隐若现 ### 文字结构 自动根据【主题】生成以下层级文案：#### 顶部小标题 一段较短的中文引子，语气克制，像在引出主题。 可拆成 2–4 行，字数不要太多。#### 中部超大主标题 提炼出一句最能概括【主题】内核的主标题。 要求：- 4~12字为佳- 足够大- 有概念密度- 适合作为海报主视觉核心 #### 下方补充文字 生成 2~4 行短句，作为补充提醒。 语气要轻、准、克制、带一点冷幽默或清醒感。 不要像营销文案，要像观察后的判断。--- # 四、右侧视觉结构（约 30%）右侧保留较大面积深黑空间，作为“被打捞出来的记忆 / 提醒”区域。元素要求：- 右上角有一只手，从画面右上方伸出- 手呈青灰色或冷灰绿色剪影感- 手指捏着一根很细的线- 细线垂直向下- 线的末端连接一个小型金属鱼钩- 鱼钩下方悬挂 3 张略微倾斜的“聊天气泡 / 纸片卡片” - 这些卡片像从深水里钓出来的记忆碎片 ### 卡片内容 根据【主题】自动生成 3 条“像被长期观察后说出的提醒”。要求：- 每条都要短- 要准- 要像真的理解了这个人- 不要空泛- 不要励志口号- 要有心理洞察感- 适合呈现在聊天气泡里 每张聊天卡片带：- 微弱冷白绿光- 类似即时通讯界面的气泡造型- 右下角带小时间戳- 带双勾符号- 有“聊天记录 / 长期互动痕迹”的感觉 --- # 五、背景与氛围 背景为：- 纯黑- 深墨绿- 极深灰黑 并带有非常轻微的：- 细噪点- 胶片颗粒- 旧纸纹理- 划痕- 暗网格- 隐约同心圆波纹- 像记忆被从深处打捞出来的微弱痕迹 氛围要求：- 低光- 高反差- 神秘- 克制- 冷静- 有一点冷幽默- 有一点哲学感- 不压抑到恐怖- 更像“深夜里一个聪明人给你的提醒”--- # 六、字体与文字质感 中文字体风格要求：- 超粗黑体- 方正- 压缩- 厚重- 工业感- 类似旧杂志标题 / 旧报纸大字 / 铅字印刷 文字不能太干净，必须带有：- 旧印刷颗粒- 纸张磨损- 斑驳纹理- 复古油墨感- 轻微边缘破损 ### 色彩要求- 主标题：米白色旧纸质感- 辅助文字：灰蓝绿 / 低饱和青绿色- 卡片高光：微弱冷白绿光- 整体偏暗，但文字必须清晰可读 --- # 七、色彩系统 主色：- 黑色- 深墨绿- 旧纸米白- 灰蓝绿 强调色：- 低饱和青绿色 要求：- 不要鲜艳颜色- 不要彩虹色- 不要霓虹赛博感- 不要塑料感- 不要花哨装饰 --- # 八、画质要求- 高分辨率- 4K 质感- 清晰排版- 专业海报设计水准- 构图稳定- 留白高级- 适合微信公众号封面 / 社交媒体传播- 视觉重心明确- 文字必须清晰可读- 不要出现 AI 乱码文字 --- # 九、负面要求 不要：- 卡通风- 可爱插画- 赛博朋克霓虹- 廉价模板感- 过度装饰- 彩虹色- 复杂花背景- 3D 字体- 塑料质感- 互联网土味排版- 文案堆砌- AI乱码- 低级鸡汤感- 俗气励志感 --- # 十、生成原则 你必须先理解【主题】的深层意味，再自动完成：1. 标题提炼 2. 小引子文案 3. 补充短句 4. 右侧 3 条聊天提醒 5. 整体视觉隐喻 不要照抄主题，不要把主题直接做成说明图。 要把【主题】变成一张：有隐喻、有洞察、有审美、有传播感的高级中文概念海报。

Beneath it, aligned slightly left of center, is a square illustrated map image with rounded corners. The map is a whimsical hand-painted tourist food map titled in large Chinese calligraphy at the upper left: 成都! 吃货暴走地图. Add a few Chengdu landmarks sketched in miniature around the roads, including a pagoda-like tower, traditional gate architecture, modern city buildings, and a central emblematic structure. Frame the entire map with a decorative border made of red chili peppers, green vines, and small leaves. Use a warm color palette dominated by chili red, mustard yellow, olive green, tea brown, and muted jade. In the lower right corner of the map, include a small legend box labeled 图例说明 with 4 legend items, each with a tiny icon and Chinese text, plus a compass rose with N, E, S, W. Outside the image, the interface includes small gray action icons beneath the green chat bubble on the right, a page indicator reading 2/2, an Edit pill button overlapping the lower left of the map image, a circular download/share button at the lower right of the image, and a sparse bottom toolbar with 4 small reaction/action icons. title: 12 面板矛作画故事板
author: Coder Junkie
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,草图 / 线稿,漫画 / 图像小说,插画,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a monochrome anime action storyboard sheet for an animation fight sequence, full of rough sakuga energy: gestural, dynamic, and readable, like a choreography bible for animators. The subject is a long-haired robed spear warrior performing a spear-and-water combat ritual across exactly 12 panels.

Canvas: Wide horizontal storyboard board, 16:9 ratio, divided into an exact 3x4 grid with thick black panel borders. Each panel has a black number badge in the upper-left corner, numbered 01 through 12, with hand-lettered uppercase titles and small color-coded annotation notes.

Visual style: Grayscale ink-and-pencil concept art with loose sketch lines, dramatic motion blur, wind-torn cloth, flying hair, splashing water, ruined coastal towers, hanging lanterns, birds in the sky, and cinematic camera angles. Keep the art mostly black, white, and gray, but overlay clear colored animator annotations: red for camera movement, blue for body mechanics, green for weapon arc, orange for impact or lantern reaction, and purple for timing or hold beats. Annotation arrows should be hand-drawn, bright, and readable.

Layout and panel content: Include exactly 12 storyboard panels:

01 — SPEAR PLANT REVEAL: The warrior stands upright on flooded stone, spear planted vertically into the water. Distant towers and seabirds behind. Red arrows show a low front wide camera move, blue notes show still stance, green arrow shows spear vertical, purple rings at the feet show stillness.

02 — TIDE BREATH: Medium side shot. The warrior extends the spear horizontally while cloth and hair flow in the wind. Red note: medium side. Blue arrows: arms rise, inhale. Green arrow: spear lifts parallel. Purple timing mark: breath hold.

03 — FIRST SWEEP CUT: Dynamic tracking-wide shot of the warrior lunging into a wide sweeping spear cut, water exploding at the feet. Red annotation: tracking wide. Blue arrows: hip rotation, low sweep. Green arc sweeps left to right across the panel. Purple note: release.

04 — SPIRAL ENTRY: Overhead or high-angle spin view. The warrior rotates in a 360-degree spiral, robes forming circular motion. Red note: orbit follow. Blue: spin 360. Green: spear orbital loop. Purple: snap at top.

05 — SALTWATER STEP: Ground-tracking shot. The warrior steps forward through shallow seawater, spear trailing outward, ripples spreading. Red: ground tracking. Blue: cross step forward. Green: water ripples outward. Purple: weight shift.

06 — PILLAR VAULT: High-angle follow shot as the warrior vaults or leaps near a tall broken pillar. Red: high angle follow. Blue: upward vault, body extend. Green: spear trails below. Purple: airborne beat.

07 — DOWNWARD PLUNGE: Front low push-in. The warrior drives the spear downward into the ground or water, creating a violent burst. Red: front low push-in. Blue: two-hand strike descend. Green: spear vertical down. Orange: impact burst. Purple: hit snap.

08 — BLADE SPIN RECOVER: Wide side view recovery stance. The warrior pivots low while the spear loops tightly around the body. Red: wide side view. Blue: behind-back loop, recover stance. Green: tight spear loop. Purple: reset breath.

09 — LANTERN PASS: Rear three-quarter composition with the warrior passing under hanging lanterns, spear extended across the frame. Red: rear 3/4. Blue: tip graze precise line. Green: spear tip path. Orange: lanterns sway, chain reaction. Purple: soft snap.

10 — TIDE SILHOUETTE: Extreme low wide shot. The warrior poses dramatically on a broken stone platform against a towering wave. Red: extreme low wide. Blue: full body pose. Green: spear overhead arc. Purple: hero pause.

11 — ROBES-TO-WATER CUT: Tracking front shot. The warrior slashes downward through water, robes whipping into the motion. Red: tracking front. Blue: slide descend steps. Green: robes trail through water. Purple: controlled flow decay.

12 — RITE UNFINISHED: Wide hero shot at sunset or pale dawn. The warrior stands facing the horizon, spear leveled forward, ocean ruins and a glowing sun in the distance. Red: wide hero shot. Blue: stand and level forward. Green: spear leveled at horizon. Purple: forward intent.

Text content: Use hand-lettered English titles exactly as listed for all 12 panels. Add small colored notes inside each panel, matching the listed red, blue, green, orange, and purple annotations. Optional main design emphasis: water-spear choreography with readable animation planning arrows.

Constraints: Exactly 12 panels in a 3x4 grid, no extra panels. Preserve the locked annotation color key: red camera, blue body, green weapon arc, orange impact, purple timing. Keep the image mostly monochrome with only the annotation colors vivid. Avoid polished clean lineart; keep it rough, energetic, cinematic, and storyboard-like.\

The main text is the poem title and verse of 定風波\\n莫聽穿林打葉聲\\n何妨吟嘯且徐行\\n竹杖芒鞋輕勝馬\\n誰怕\\n一蓑煙雨任平生\\n料峭春風吹酒醒\\n微冷\\n山頭斜照卻相迎\\n回首向來蕭瑟處\\n歸去\\n也無風雨也無晴, written with expressive literati brushwork, varied pressure, dry-brush texture, natural ink spread, and lively stroke rhythm reminiscent of a Song-dynasty masterpiece interpreted by a Jin-style calligrapher. Add a smaller left-side inscription in 3 vertical columns containing 蘇軾詞定風波\\n癸卯春\\n奚義之書, with the inscription thinner and more restrained than the main text. Include exactly 5 red cinnabar seals with carved seal-script impressions: 1 small square seal near the upper right margin, 3 vertically stacked rectangular seals along the mid-to-lower right edge, and 1 square seal near the lower left beside the inscription. The paper should show subtle fibers, warm foxing, soft tonal unevenness, and gentle age wear, while the lighting remains even, diffuse, and archival, emphasizing authentic texture and the contrast between black ink and tan paper. Keep the background entirely occupied by the scroll surface, with a calm scholarly antique aesthetic and no modern objects.\

The left panel occupies the left third of the canvas, the right panel occupies the right third, and the center column contains the text and arrow.

Subject details: In both panels, depict the same dynamic high-quality anime-style female ninja, Ai-chan, leaping through the air in a dramatic action pose. She has long flowing blonde hair tied high, a face obscured by a square tan blur censor block, black fingerless gloves, and a purple floral kimono-style kunoichi outfit with pink cherry blossom patterns, short skirt, thigh straps, belt pouches, and soft ninja boots. She wields exactly 3 visible weapons: 2 short swords crossed above her head in both hands and 1 curved sword drawn diagonally across her body at waist level. Her pose has one knee raised high and the other leg bent back, with strong motion and wind-swept hair.

Left panel: A detailed but slightly softer anime illustration of the kunoichi in front of a Japanese temple complex at sunset. Include stone stairs, a red pagoda, curved temple roof eaves, stone guardian lion statues, distant misty mountains, pink sky, cherry blossom branches, falling petals, and a faint spiral of pink magical energy around the character.

Right panel: A more polished, sharper, higher-detail, more cinematic version of the same scene, with richer contrast, denser cherry blossoms, more ornate roof carvings, stronger lighting, more saturated sunset colors, more petals, clearer stone textures, brighter pink energy swirl, and extra environmental detail. Keep the same character pose and outfit but make the rendering noticeably more refined than the left panel.

Visual style: Ultra high-quality cinematic anime art, extremely fine linework, soft shading, high detail, dramatic rim lighting, glossy highlights on blades, sakura-pink atmosphere, fantasy action composition, intricate Japanese architecture, dynamic motion blur only on petals and hair, sharp character focus.

Constraints: Preserve the white center gap and white outer margins. Do not add logos, watermarks, social-media UI, extra captions, or additional panels. Keep the face intentionally obscured by the square blur in both panels.\
